text:
zoe: Quick convo 10m: designing the per-request audit link for automatic fallbacks. Need product/ops constraints.
jihoon: TLDR: decision_id mandatory, compact meta for list view, full payload behind auth and sampling.
anita: UX: inline badge "served: fallback" + chevron -> micro panel. Panel shows short reason, cost delta, and 'open full audit' link. Use icon + text for accessibility.
mike: Ops: retention defaults: meta 90d, full 365d archived if compliance flagged. Tenants can set sample_rate.
jihoon: API sketch: GET /decisions/{id}?view=compact|full. compact ~200B, full varies. Include a short human_message in compact (<140 chars).
anita: Microcopy variants: "Response shortened for latency" vs "Content withheld for safety". Different icons.
zoe: Billing note: bill on served model; include charge_breakdown in audit so finance can recompute. Need product signoff.
mike: Operator overrides should append an override event referencing decision_id, do not mutate original. CLI: `rictl decisions get <id>`.
deploy-bot: Deployed: decision-audit-endpoint v1.0 by jihoon  migration: add decision_id index.
zoe: Action items: anita mock micro panel, jihoon implement compact/full endpoints + sampling knob, mike docs retention + overrides. I'll write a short PRD after mocks. Thanks! :thumbsup:
